author: Bobby Grayson
description: Observed while proving Grows.trans / Frame.trans and the Fresh lemmas: goals like q < a.next -> a.next <= b.next -> q < b.next over Pid fail under omega because Pid is an abbrev for Nat in this toolchain. Proof authors extending SysProps should reach for Nat lemmas directly. Not a bug in the library, just a cost for future contributors.
title: Toolchain quirk: omega does not see through abbrev Pid := Nat on Lean v4.33.1, so pid arithmetic in SysProps.lean uses Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le / Nat.le_trans explicitly; noted in the module docstring
